reasoning: The question asks whether Gukesh's FIDE ranking on 2025-11-02 will be as high or higher than on 2025-10-26. Based on the evidence, Gukesh's October 2025 rating is 2752 (down 15 points from September's 2767). The FIDE World Cup 2025 begins October 30 in Goa, with Gukesh as top seed. Between October 26 and November 2, Gukesh will participate in rounds 1-3 of the World Cup (November 1-9 schedule). His rating change depends on tournament performance. Given that: (1) he's the top seed and reigning world champion, (2) he recently underperformed at the Grand Swiss, (3) the World Cup is a knockout format where results are unpredictable, and (4) rating changes depend on opponent strength and results, there's meaningful uncertainty. However, as the top seed facing lower-rated opponents in early rounds, he's more likely to gain or maintain rating than lose significantly. The 7-day window is relatively short for major rating swings.
